editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Deriv is a legitimate mid-tier regulated broker scoring 6.6/10 from NAFT in 2026. Operating since 1999 (originally Binary.com), it serves a specific niche — emerging market traders who need ultra-low deposits, high leverage, and access to synthetic indices that trade 24/7. The $5 minimum, seven trading platforms, and 300+ instruments make it genuinely accessible. But the withdrawal complaint pattern is severe and well-documented, no Tier-1 regulator oversees retail operations, and synthetic index pricing is proprietary and unverifiable. Deriv works for the trader who understands these trade-offs. It is not a platform for anyone who expects the protections of FCA or ASIC oversight.
